title: Palindrome Permutation
statement: Decide whether the characters of `s` can be reordered to spell a palindrome, that is, a string that is identical when read from left to right and from right to left. Every character must be used exactly once, and keeping `s` in its current order counts as one of the orderings. Return `true` if at least one ordering is a palindrome and `false` otherwise.
constraints: s contains only lowercase English letters
notes:
## Intuition

Trying every ordering is factorial work. Instead, look at what a palindrome needs: each character on the left half has a twin at the mirrored position on the right half, so every letter appears an even number of times, except possibly one letter that sits alone in the middle of an odd-length palindrome. Conversely, if at most one letter has an odd count, we can always lay out the pairs symmetrically and put the odd one out in the centre. So the answer depends only on how many letters occur an odd number of times.

## Approach

1. Count each letter of `s` in a 26-slot array `counts`.
2. Walk over `counts` and increase `odd` for every `count` that is odd.
3. Return `odd <= 1`.

## Example 1, step by step

`s = "code"`: `counts` has 1 for each of `c`, `o`, `d`, `e` and 0 elsewhere. Four letters have an odd count, so `odd = 4` and the answer is `false`.

(For `"carerac"` the counts are `c: 2`, `a: 2`, `r: 2`, `e: 1`, so `odd = 1` and the answer is `true`: `e` goes in the middle of `racecar`.)

## Complexity

- Time: O(n) to count the letters, plus O(26) to scan the counts.
- Space: O(1): the array always has 26 slots.

## Pitfalls

- Do not require an even length: one odd count is fine (the middle letter).
- Count odd letters, not letters with count 1; a letter appearing 3 times is also odd.
- Checking whether `s` itself is a palindrome is a different question: any reordering is allowed.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `counts` | how many times each letter `a`..`z` appears |
| `i` | position in `s` while counting |
| `count` | one letter's total while scanning `counts` |
| `odd` | how many letters appear an odd number of times |

narration.2: One counter per lowercase letter, all starting at zero.
narration.3: Visit every character of s once.
narration.4: Turn the character into an index 0..25 and count it.
narration.7: odd will hold how many letters cannot be fully paired up.
narration.9: An odd total leaves one copy of this letter without a mirror partner.
narration.13: A palindrome can host at most one unpaired letter, in its middle.
